scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --json | node -e "let data = ''; process.stdin.on('data', chunk => data += chunk); process.stdin.on('end', () => { const files = JSON.parse(data)[0]?.files?.map(file => file.path) ?? []; for (const required of ['dist/moodle.js', 'SKILL.md', 'references/command-reference.md', 'agents/openai.yaml']) if (!files.includes(required)) throw new Error('npm package is missing ' + required); });"
scripts.pack:smoke: tmp="$(mktemp -d)" && npm pack ../cli-kit --pack-destination "$tmp" >/dev/null && npm pack --pack-destination "$tmp" >/dev/null && npm install --prefix "$tmp/install" "$tmp"/bunizao-cli-kit-*.tgz "$tmp"/moodle-cli-*.tgz >/dev/null && test "$("$tmp/install/node_modules/.bin/moodle" --version)" = "$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')).version")"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run build
